trust_decision.summary: Markdown, including raw HTML inside it, is untrusted: every URL-valued attribute must be dropped unless its scheme is allowed. The decision lives in isAnchorLinkAllowed/validateProp (src/runtime/parser/utils/props.ts:21-55) and is applied exactly once, at compile time, by validateProps from src/runtime/parser/compiler.ts:82; nothing re-checks at render time. The pinned code consults the deny-list on url.protocol, which is only the bare scheme, and only inspects the attribute names href and src.

landing_point.why: The summary names both misses (SVG xlink:href, data:text/html); the only place the prefix list is consulted is isAnchorLinkAllowed, and the line that fails for data:text/html is the url.protocol comparison at props.ts:33, one function in one file.

The fix's own test asserts safe xlinkhref values stay allowed (fix.diff:69-74).
